entry_rule: Only a PRE_CONFIRMATION/EARLY_CONFIRMATION -> CONFIRMING transition, or PULLBACK -> CONFIRMING recovery, can create an entry trigger. No fixed momentum threshold is invented.
rule: No score can override causal/provenance/reaction gates. Same-snapshot V3 autonomous research is preferred; stale V3 research is never consumed. Any scanner-carried activation fields are overwritten by the selected current-run activation artifact before decisioning. Entry triggers must pass private portfolio risk before BUY. Existing positions use private thesis/risk gates for HOLD/REDUCE/EXIT. Shadow validation is ex-post only and cannot rewrite history or tune thresholds.

risk_layer.privacy_rule: Private holdings/balances/weights/risk groups and derived metrics are consumed in-memory only and never committed or printed.

existing_position_layer.privacy_rule: Per-position actions, tickers, balances, weights and P/L stay in-memory and are never committed or logged.
